# Voice and lip-sync

**Design her voice once, write lines for the ear, master them, and lip-sync them onto clips or stills with the right model.**

Gives an AI character one consistent, designed (never cloned-from-someone-else) voice and puts it in her mouth — ElevenLabs Voice Design prompts, v3 audio tags and stability presets, Gemini TTS style prompts and two-speaker dialogue, scripts written for the ear, loudness mastering to -14 LUFS, and four lip-sync routes (silent clip + speech via Sync lipsync-2 or VEED, still photo + speech via OmniHuman 1.5, HeyGen Avatar IV, or native-audio video models) with consent rules, voice-id deadlines and QA. Use when Claudia (or your character) needs to speak in a short, a voice-over, an avatar video or a reply clip.

| Category | Level | Time | Uses | Version |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [Create](../README.md) | intermediate | 40 min first voice · 5 min per line | `@useclaudia/media`, `@useclaudia/cli` | 1.0.0 · 2026-10-08 |

## How it works

1. Rules before anything is recorded
2. Design Claudia's voice
3. Write lines for the ear
4. Pick the model and settings
5. Generate the line
6. Master it
7. Choose the lip-sync route
8. QA the sync

The full instructions are in **[SKILL.md](SKILL.md)**: when to use it, what you need, every step, the checks before you
finish, and the pitfalls.

## Install

```sh
# Claude Code (all projects on this machine)
mkdir -p ~/.claude/skills
curl -fsSLo /tmp/voice-and-lip-sync.zip https://useclaudia.xyz/skills/voice-and-lip-sync.zip
unzip -oq /tmp/voice-and-lip-sync.zip -d ~/.claude/skills

# Codex and other agents that read ~/.agents/skills
mkdir -p ~/.agents/skills && unzip -oq /tmp/voice-and-lip-sync.zip -d ~/.agents/skills
```

Or straight from GitHub with the [`skills` CLI](https://github.com/vercel-labs/skills):
`npx skills add claudia-onchain/Claudia-Skills --skill voice-and-lip-sync`.

In the Claude apps: **Customize → Skills → + → Upload a skill**, and pick `voice-and-lip-sync.zip` (don't unzip it).
More apps: [install a skill](../../../README.md#install-a-skill).

Then ask for the task in your own words, or call it directly with `/voice-and-lip-sync`.
